system:
You are a NEUTRAL AI case assessor supporting an ombudsman in a dispute between Corbel Mutual Insurance (which declined a claim) and Penrose Bakeries Pty Ltd (the insured business).

Question: How likely is it that Corbel Mutual was entitled to decline Penrose Bakeries' claim for non-disclosure? P=0 clearly not entitled; P=50 genuinely balanced; P=100 clearly entitled.

Calibration: P=50 means the evidence so far is genuinely balanced. It is correct and expected to stay near 50 when items cut both ways; move only as far as the evidence actually warrants, and state your confidence honestly.

You will receive the items one at a time. After each item, give your assessment based only on the items received so far. You will not be able to revise earlier assessments.

After each item reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"p": <0-100>, "conf": "<LOW|MED|HIGH>", "reason": "<15 words or fewer>"}
When told all items have been provided, reply with ONE JSON object:
{"p": <0-100>, "conf": "<LOW|MED|HIGH>", "reason": "<one line>"}

exchanges.user:
=== EVIDENCE BUNDLE (submitted by the parties; weigh each item critically, and note that any cover-notes are the parties' own characterisations, not findings) ===
[Instructing note]: Instructing note: Please assess the enclosed bundle in the Corbel/Penrose complaint and give a running, calibrated view on whether the insurer was entitled to decline the claim. The record is mixed; weigh each item on its merits.

=== ITEM 1 ===
The proposal form asked: 'Have you made any insurance claims in the last five years?' The policy lets Corbel refuse a claim if a non-disclosure would have led it to decline cover or to offer cover on materially different terms.

Your assessment after item 1:
exchanges.text: {"p": 50, "conf": "LOW", "reason": "Only framework established; no facts on disclosure or materiality yet."}

exchanges.user:
=== ITEM 2 ===
The proposal was completed by Penrose's broker. The broker's file note of the call with the owner reads: 'mentioned the 2022 water damage, all repaired'. The broker did not record it on the form.

Your assessment after item 2:
exchanges.text: {"p": 44, "conf": "LOW", "reason": "Owner disclosed to broker; broker's omission, though broker typically insured's agent."}

exchanges.user:
=== ITEM 3 ===
The current loss is a fire caused by an electrical fault in an oven, assessed at AUD 410,000 including business interruption. The loss adjuster records no connection to any water or flood damage.

Your assessment after item 3:
exchanges.text: {"p": 42, "conf": "LOW", "reason": "No causal link; relevance depends on jurisdiction, but materiality still untested."}

exchanges.user:
=== ITEM 4 ===
Corbel's underwriting file shows that a commercial claims-database check returned 'prior property claim - details unknown' for the address. There is no record that the underwriter followed it up.

Your assessment after item 4:
exchanges.text: {"p": 36, "conf": "MED", "reason": "Insurer had notice of prior claim, didn't inquire; undermines inducement/materiality."}

exchanges.user:
=== ITEM 5 ===
Corbel's decline letter cites non-disclosure of the 2022 claim. Penrose's complaint says disclosure was made through its broker and offers to pay any additional premium that would have applied.

Your assessment after item 5:
exchanges.text: {"p": 35, "conf": "MED", "reason": "Positions restated; premium offer hints remedy is adjustment, not full decline."}

exchanges.user:
=== ITEM 6 ===
Penrose made a flood claim of AUD 85,000 in 2022, under a different insurer, for the same premises. The proposal form answered the prior-claims question 'No'.

Your assessment after item 6:
exchanges.text: {"p": 39, "conf": "MED", "reason": "Confirms a real, sizable undisclosed claim and a false answer; materiality still open."}

exchanges.user:
=== ITEM 7 ===
Corbel's 2023 underwriting guidelines say a prior flood claim at the same premises requires referral to a senior underwriter and either a flood exclusion or a premium loading of at least 30%.

Your assessment after item 7:
exchanges.text: {"p": 48, "conf": "MED", "reason": "Shows materially different terms likely; but terms wouldn't have excluded fire loss."}

exchanges.user:
=== ITEM 8 ===
The owner signed the proposal declaration: 'I have read the answers in this proposal and they are true and complete.'

Your assessment after item 8:
exchanges.text: {"p": 52, "conf": "MED", "reason": "Signed declaration binds owner to the false 'No' despite broker's error."}

exchanges.user: All items have been provided. Give your FINAL assessment.
exchanges.text: {"p": 50, "conf": "MED", "reason": "Genuine non-disclosure of a material prior claim, owner-signed; but insurer ignored its own database flag, the loss is unrelated, and the 'different terms' (flood exclusion/loading) would not have barred this fire claim—entitlement to decline outright is finely balanced, with proportionate adjustment the likelier fair outcome."}
